sloka: एव सम्मानिताश्चैते मानार्हा मानद त्वया ।भविष्यन्ति कृतज्ञेन निर्वृता हरियूथपाः ।। ६.१२५.८ ।।
transliteration: eva sammānitāścaite mānārhā mānada tvayā ।bhaviṣyanti kṛtajñena nirvṛtā hariyūthapāḥ ।। 6.125.8 ।।

translations.english: "If you do so you will be called as charitable and kind, not seizing wealth and as one who has gained over senses. That is why I am telling you for so long."
